name: run_command_table_until_input
description: Copies 32 bytes in reverse order, then loops over a per-step command table, calling sub-routines for each non-zero code and polling input and interrupt state until a flag ends the loop.

name: enable_audio_interrupt_then_clear
description: Writes an interrupt-enable value with the set bit on, then calls the routine that silences the four audio channels and turns off audio DMA.

name: advance_command_table_step
description: Clears a status flag, advances the step counter, and runs one or two sub-routines selected by the table code at the new step, repeating until the status flag is set.

name: dispatch_sequence_step_codes
description: Waits on the step timer, then reads step codes from a table: code three calls one routine, code four calls two, and codes one and two restart the sequence.

name: run_sequence_with_restart
description: Loops over a step table, waiting for the timer and polling a status flag between steps; code two restarts the wait, code three repeats the loop, and code four calls two routines before continuing.

name: run_sequence_with_double_call
description: Calls two routines at the start of each pass, then waits for the timer and reads step codes; code two jumps to a handler, code three calls one routine, and code four ends the pass so it starts again with two calls.

name: advance_four_step_counter
description: Increments a byte counter that wraps back to zero after reaching three, with routines called before and after the increment.

name: chain_two_helper_calls
description: Makes two calls to other routines in sequence and does nothing else, so it only orders those two steps.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other with no state of its own.

name: call_pair_back_to_back
description: Calls two routines back to back with no state of its own, then returns.

name: increment_counter_with_flag
description: Runs several routines, increments a byte counter, and sets a flag to one only while one of the calls runs, clearing it afterwards. An extra routine runs first when a control byte equals a double-quote character.

name: arm_audio_interrupt_then_clear
description: Writes an interrupt-enable value with the set bit on, then calls the routine that silences the four audio channels and turns off audio DMA.

name: store_interrupt_request_constant
description: Calls one routine, then writes a fixed constant to the interrupt request register, returning with the data registers unchanged.

name: init_audio_sample_pointers
description: Scans a byte table for a level value, uses the matching index to fill fourteen sample pointer slots, and zeroes the stored audio volume settings.

name: update_audio_channel_period
description: Counts six ticks per cycle; on the sixth it sets the channel's sample address from the level table, waits briefly and enables DMA, while on other ticks it runs the active effects and slides or looks up the channel period written to the audio hardware.

name: apply_audio_channel_effects
description: Runs the effect routine for each channel whose flag is set, then applies the channel's effect command: a slide down or up with clamping, or a table lookup for the current mode, writing the result to the channel register.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so calling it has no effect.

name: apply_channel_effect_from_record
description: Applies an effect to a channel record in memory: a low-nibble code of one slides the record's running value down, two slides it up, both clamped to fixed limits, and other nonzero codes leave it alone. With code zero it selects a table entry from the current mode and copies it to the record's output field.

name: slide_channel_value_down
description: Subtracts the record's parameter byte from its running value, clamps the result to a lower limit, and copies it to the output field.

name: slide_channel_value_up
description: Adds the record's parameter byte to its running value, clamps the result to an upper limit, and copies it to the output field.

name: lookup_channel_value_by_mode
description: Selects a table index from the parameter byte according to the current mode, then searches a word table for the record's stored key and copies the entry at that index to the output field; mode three copies the record's stored value directly.

name: lookup_channel_value_high_nibble
description: Searches a word table for the record's stored key and copies the entry at the index given by the high nibble of the parameter byte to the output field.

name: lookup_channel_value_low_nibble
description: Searches a word table for the record's stored key and copies the entry at the index given by the low nibble of the parameter byte to the output field.

name: copy_channel_stored_value
description: Copies the record's stored value field directly to the channel's output field.

name: lookup_channel_value_by_index
description: Searches a word table for the record's stored key and copies the entry at the index passed in by the caller to the output field.

name: store_channel_output_value
description: Writes a word passed in by the caller to the channel's output field.

name: start_audio_dma_channels
description: Computes the next sample address from a table, calls four channel routines and waits briefly, then sets the DMA-enable bit and starts each channel whose flag is set.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: process_channel_sequence_step
description: Reads the next four-byte step of a channel's sequence and, when the step's leading word is nonzero, advances the channel's timing and position fields. It then executes one effect selected by the low nibble of the step's command byte.

name: apply_channel_sequence_effect
description: Updates a channel's timing and position fields from the current step, then executes the effect selected by the low nibble of the step's command byte.

name: negate_state_and_store_count
description: Bitwise-inverts a state word and stores the step's parameter byte minus one into a counter.

name: store_channel_parameter_byte
description: Copies the step's parameter byte into a byte field of the channel record.

name: set_state_to_inverted_one
description: Sets a state word to one and then inverts it, leaving every bit set except bit zero.

name: set_state_bit_from_param
description: Copies bit zero of the step's parameter byte into bit one of a state word and leaves the other bits unchanged.

name: store_nonzero_nibble_state
description: Takes the low nibble of the step's parameter byte and, when it is nonzero, clears a state word and stores that nibble in it.
